title: This tour was...
text: This tour was everything!!! Please book with Daniel, he is very knowledgeable and really took us all the amazing hot spots of Barcelona! He presented different cuisines I would never try and I’m so glad I listened to his intuition because my palate has changed from this tour! Daniel is friendly and welcoming! We are from Los Angeles and so glad we booked with him right when we landed!
author: BreAnn_G

title: Best food tour, yummy food with good fun
text:

title: Our tipsy tour guide was...
text: Our tipsy tour guide was Lindsay and she was great! She took us to El Born and the Gothic quarter; stopped at 4 different places and had 3 drinks. I recommend doing this in the beginning of your trip in Barcelona.
author: Jobel_S

title: Great way to get to know a new city!
text: Fun and knowledgeable guide Lindsey!  Fun facts and history included worth the stops for sampling food and drinks.
author: Bradley_W

title: Tipsy Tapas Tour
text:
We loved this tour! 

Sky was our guide and was amazing. We did the 1:00 tour and had a group of 14. 
Sky had us all departing on time and onto our first location. She kept us entertained and under control. 
We went to 4 different restaurants and had so much food! Ended the tour with seafood paella. 
It was the perfect tour for my birthday and Sky went out of her way to make sure we had birthday apple pie!
Would recommend this tour to all foodies!!
author: Jrtycholis

title: Fun time!
text: Mariah was an awesome host- had lots of fun with our group- got a little tipsy and had loads of tapas!

title: EPIC TIPSY + TAPAS TOUR
text:
Rolene, Rolene, Rolennnnnnnne!!!!!!!!!!

I had an absolutely wonderful time on the  TIPSY + TAPAS tour with Rolene as our guide. 

The tour was very entertaining, we tried delicious food, tasty drinks, and had really good vibes with the group. Rolene was  knowledgeable with the history and legends of the area. 

Looking forward to more tipsy tours in different locations!!!!

With love from Turks and Caicos ~ Rita
